messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas (as of 2024)** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits are enforceable; no “reasonable speed” exception.
• Speed limit signs are mandatory on all public roads. | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the driver on the right has priority.
• Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks. | | **School Bus Laws** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops and displays red lights. | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Overtaking on the right is prohibited unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | | **Parking Regulations** | • Parking on sidewalks, crosswalks, or in front of driveways is prohibited.
• No parking within 20 feet of a fire hydrant. | | **Traffic Signal Compliance** | • Red light means stop; green means go; yellow means prepare to stop.
• Must obey flashing amber signals. | | **Vehicle Inspection & Registration** | • Annual vehicle inspection required for most vehicles.
• Registration renewal is due annually. | For detailed statutes, consult the Texas Transportation Code or the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles website.
message.reasoning: The user wants information about traffic laws in Texas. We can provide general info. But we might also use the lawsuit_search function? The user didn't ask about lawsuits. They just want traffic laws. So we can answer directly. No function call needed.
